parity.reason: k 7->8: dedup fix recovered Alpha Omega MAIN (20929341, HR 1.01) that the old latest-year rule dropped for its statin-user subgroup. comparator pooled 22 for MACE but ~12 are physiologic/arrhythmia; ~7 large outcome trials (DART/GISSI-P/JELIS/GISSI-HF/AlphaOmega/AREDS2/DART-2) = reach gap

refusals.trial: DART, GISSI-Prevenzione, JELIS, GISSI-HF (comparator's large reach-gap trials)
refusals.verified: FDA/EMA + multi-registry (ISRCTN/EU-CTR/ICTRP) adapters were built and run against these gaps
refusals.not_pooled_because: MEASURED REACH WALL: these are old published RCTs (1989-2008) that predate the registries and are not FDA/EMA approval trials, so none is reachable via openFDA, Drugs@FDA, ISRCTN, EU-CTR or ICTRP. The FDA adapter reaches only newer approval-label trials (e.g. REDUCE-IT, which we already pool). Registry-and-regulatory reach does NOT cover older literature; the lever for these is citation-chasing of the comparator's own reference list, not a regulatory adapter.
